notes: GMTK Game Jam 2026 (https://noname90.itch.io/secondsbeforethebreath). itch credits Noname90 (zankorobos13) for programming and game design, and grigogo for 2D art, music, and game design (grigogo is not in git history). Complete Unity 2022.3.6f1 submarine-captain simulator with playable Menu, Main, Submarine, Lose, and Win scenes in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2026 zankorobos13). Official Unity packages only (2D feature 2.0.0, URP 14.0.8, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6, Timeline, uGUI, Visual Scripting, and built-in modules). Liberation Sans (OFL 1.1) is the bundled TMP default font. Main_theme.mp3 is credited to grigogo and kept under the same MIT grant. Freesound-downloaded SFX could not be verified as redistributable and were omitted (Alert, Error, Explosion, Success, Step1–3, and Submarine.mp3; the last was tagged as theredshore CC0 Freesound 83977 rowrow but the audio does not match that file). Unsourced Environment/BG.PNG (photoreal coral reef) and Win/Lose JPEGs (Apple Photos Clean Up / compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia) were replaced in place with original flat graphics made for this snapshot (md5 a42e5710180d3ea7155131c9c9fc2e2c / a3c408ebe3c838d136144306f9fafdcc / 025d9669d177a11df5ed696cc873448e); .meta guids unchanged. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset and TMP Documentation were omitted; TMP Settings m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared because it pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL.
